"use client" import { ChevronsUpDown } from "lucide-react" import type { ComponentProps, ReactNode } from "react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" export type DashboardAccountUser = { name: string email: string image?: string | null } export function DashboardAccountMenu({ user, menuItems, signOutItem, }: { user: DashboardAccountUser menuItems?: ReactNode signOutItem?: ReactNode }) { const initials = user.name .split(" ") .map((part) => part[0]) .join("") .slice(0, 2) .toUpperCase() return ( {initials}
{user.name} {user.email}
{initials}
{user.name} {user.email}
{menuItems ? ( <> {menuItems} ) : null} {signOutItem ? ( <> {signOutItem} ) : null} ) } export function DashboardAccountMenuItem({ children, ...props }: ComponentProps) { return ( {children} ) }

"use client" import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react" import Shell from "@/components/ui/shell" import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader, SidebarInset, SidebarProvider, SidebarRail, SidebarSeparator, } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { SHELL_HEADER_HEIGHT } from "./shell-constants" import { DashboardHeader } from "./dashboard-header" import { TopNavShell } from "./top-nav-shell" export type DashboardShellProps = { sidebarHeader?: ReactNode sidebarContent?: ReactNode sidebarFooter?: ReactNode headerActions?: ReactNode children: ReactNode className?: string defaultSidebarOpen?: boolean showBreadcrumbs?: boolean /** When false, renders `TopNavShell` (header + main only). */ showSidebar?: boolean sidebarCollapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none" topNavigation?: ReactNode } export function DashboardShell({ sidebarHeader, sidebarContent, sidebarFooter, headerActions, children, className, defaultSidebarOpen = true, showBreadcrumbs = true, showSidebar = true, sidebarCollapsible = "icon", topNavigation, }: DashboardShellProps) { if (!showSidebar) { return ( {children} ) } return (
{sidebarHeader ? {sidebarHeader} : null} {sidebarContent} {sidebarFooter ? ( <> {sidebarFooter} ) : null} {children}
) }
